notes_markdown:
### Berkeley conversations — plan

- Confirmed: Sep 9 Elena Park (learning sciences PhD), Sep 10 Priya Raman (education + HCI PhD); Sep 16 Ben Adeyemi (stats postdoc) on Zoom
- David leads, Hudson takes notes; record only with permission (Granola on, ask first)
- No demo in the first three; ask to see their actual setup (screen share or laptop)
- Gift: $25 coffee card each

### Interview guide draft (v0)

1. Walk me through the last time you started a new project. Where did the idea come from?
2. Show me where your notes for it live right now.
3. When you write a paper, how do you find the thing you read / said months ago?
4. Where do AI chats fit? Do you ever go back to old ones?
5. What did you try that you stopped using? Why?
6. If you could ask your past self one question about this project, what would it be?

### Importer status

- Claude importer done; ChatGPT importer handles branches (current_node walk) — 2 fixtures failing on deleted conversations
- Zotero spike: Hudson found attachments are keyed by 8-char folder names in `storage/`; linked files (not stored) need the path from `itemAttachments`
- PDF hashing: Zotero doesn't rewrite PDFs on annotation (annotations live in the DB) → byte hash OK for Zotero, still normalize text for Downloads copies

- [ ] David — finalize guide, send to Lena Thu
- [ ] Hudson — buy coffee cards; confirm rooms with Elena/Priya
- [ ] David — fix deleted-conversation fixtures
- [ ] Hudson — Zotero linked-file paths
